zh.title: 國防部偵獲中共15機艦船台海活動 2架輔戰機進入西南空域
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲中共15機艦船台海活動；2架輔戰機進入西南空域；國軍嚴密監控
body: 台灣國防部於8月11日表示，自8月10日上午6時至11日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲中共2架次軍機、7艘共艦及6艘公務船，總計15艘次機艦船持續在台灣海峽周邊活動。國防部指出，中共相關動態適逢國軍漢光42號實兵演習進入第7天。
根據國防部公布之「中共解放軍進入台海周邊空域活動示意圖」，國軍於10日上午8時25分至下午1時50分，在海峽中線以東之台灣西南空域，偵獲中共2架次輔戰機活動。
面對中共機艦與公務船活動，國防部強調，國軍已運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，對台海周邊動態實施嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 15 Chinese Military Aircraft and Ships Around Island
en.summary: Taiwan MND detected 15 Chinese aircraft and vessels around the strait; two aircraft entered southwest airspace
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 11 that it detected 15 Chinese military aircraft, naval vessels, and official ships operating around the Taiwan Strait between 06:00 on August 10 and 06:00 on August 11. The total included two PLA aircraft, seven naval vessels, and six official ships. The activity occurred as Taiwan's armed forces entered the seventh day of the Han Kuang 42 live-fire exercise.

According to an activity map released by the defense ministry, two PLA auxiliary aircraft were detected operating in Taiwan's southwestern airspace east of the median line between 08:25 and 13:50 on August 10.
In response to the Chinese military presence, Taiwan's military deployed task aircraft, naval ships, and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the operations.
